rule.description:
Detects the execution of multiple system and network discovery commands within a short timeframe and launched by the same parent process.
Attackers execute discovery commands to gather information about the compromised system and network environment in order to identify privileges, running processes, network configuration, and potential lateral movement opportunities.
It is recommended to analyze the parent process and execution context of the detected commands to determine whether they originate from legitimate administrative activity or from potentially malicious post-compromise reconnaissance.
rule.name: Discovery Commands Executed via Command-Line
